satHelpPaymentComplementBody: The CFDI that proves a payment against a PPD invoice was received. One is stamped per payment, no later than the 5th of the following month. PUE invoices do not need one, since they were paid as they were issued.
satHelpPaymentMethodBody: PUE is when the customer pays in full as the invoice is issued. PPD is when they will pay later or in installments, and then every payment needs its own payment complement.
satHelpProductKeyBody: SAT catalog key that states what you are selling. If you cannot find your exact product, identifying the class it belongs to is enough.
satHelpUnitKeyBody: Unit of measure from the SAT catalog, for example E48 for services or H87 for pieces. It lives in the same catalog as the product key.
